subject.name_or_desc: A pet cat, missing from its London home

context.question: Will the cat come home?
context.setting: The cat has been gone long enough for the owner to worry. The chart is cast by the astrologer in London using Regiomontanus houses.

attachments.chart: Horary figure, 30 August 1998, 09:20 BST, London; Regiomontanus houses
attachments.note: Small animals are signified by the 6th house; the cat's significator is Lord 6

provenance.work: John Frawley, The Horary Textbook (2005), lost-cat worked example; summary: Ken Saunders, 4phases.com, 15 March 2026
